summary: Slice 5 of 5. Wired the R11 executable flag through the remaining UI: the Sidebar app status dot now counts only executable terminals (matching Start all / Stop all and F5), and EditPane has a labelled executable checkbox per terminal whose value draft() always writes (an old config with no flag saves as executable). Added the R10 mobile-first pass to CommandPalette.module.css: the base now fills the width, sits at the top and is bounded by 100dvh so the on-screen keyboard cannot squeeze the list, with a @media (min-width: 640px) block restoring the current 12vh / min(560px,100%) / 60vh centred palette. Bumped the app version to 2.3.0 in package.json, src-tauri/Cargo.toml, src-tauri/tauri.conf.json and src-tauri/Cargo.lock, plus the package-lock.json entry and the two tests that assert the shipped version (App.test.tsx footer and App.version.test.tsx); package-lock.json and App.version.test.tsx are needed to keep the version suite green although the design scope did not list them. Added R11/R10 tests and left the already-built R9 explorer ops untouched. Verified (version files are kept in step; the version assertion test is not a feature requirement): npm run lint, npm run build, full npm test (634 pass), cargo clippy -D warnings, and cargo tests explorer_ops/editor_repath/terminal_executable.
